items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: He played piano, then later he turned on to play Tujo.

ctx.x: He played piano, then later he turned on to play Tujo. Jackson, yeah. He had a big everything. You remember? Who did? Jackson. He played piano, then later he turned on to play Tujo. Jackson, yeah. He had a big everything. You remember? He was a big guy. He was a big guy. He was a big guy.
Buster, I think, played with him for a while. And Dick Thompson. Buster Buster. No, no.
